route_note: The app's own Makefile (src/dxtc2-cuda, ORNL/HeCBench at the two commits), nvcc -O3 -arch=sm_89 -lineinfo, identical flags for both variants. One change to the Makefile's CFLAGS (reproduced on the make command line): -std=c++14 -> -std=c++17, because CUDA 13.4's libcu++ (included through cooperative_groups.h) stops under C++14 with 'error: libcu++ requires at least C++ 17' (the define CCCL_IGNORE_DEPRECATED_CPP_DIALECT only moves the failure into libcu++, 97 errors). Kernel source untouched. Link only: -Xlinker -rpath=$ORIGIN, and the gcc-12.4 runtime libs (libstdc++.so.6, libgcc_s.so.1, libgomp.so.1) are copied next to the binary (the system libstdc++ is gcc 8, no static libstdc++.a exists), so the artifact runs from BeeGFS without LD_LIBRARY_PATH (checked with env -i ldd).
driver: ./main ./lena32.ppm ./lena32_ref.dds 1: one launch compress<<<64, 64>>> (blocks = 64 4x4 DXT1 blocks of a 32x32 image, 64 threads per block, 1 iteration). The racy helpers run in lanes 0-15 of warp 0 of each block.
input: lena_std.ppm (repo: src/dxtc2-sycl/data/) cropped to its top-left 32x32 pixels, with the corresponding 64 DXT1 blocks of lena_ref.dds as reference, both written by targets/hecbench-dxtc2-1/crop.py at build time (input preparation, no code edited; artifacts lena32.ppm, lena32_ref.dds).
